description: SU(3) BMN non-graviton classes restricted to SU(2) x U(1) at the representative level: for each sector, explicit representatives of the non-graviton classes (fortuity.hwcoh.classreps_par), the coefficient of x^alpha of their block restriction (R-016) in every channel whose SU(2) target holds non-graviton classes (the fused capacity of fortuity.hwcoh.cores), reduced modulo exact + graviton there; restriction_rank = number of fused classes, cores = non-graviton classes minus restriction_rank (T-032 follow-up, R-024)
computed_by: Fortuity collaboration (Claude agents) on Harvard FASRC (reps.sbatch: the five medium sectors submitted 2026-10-10, the heavy (6;8,5,4) one 2026-10-11)
code: code/fortuity/hwcoh/classreps_par.py (commit d88f5c3) via scripts/bmn/su3-cores/reps/run_reps.py (commit c1e3fe3); SEED=1, MAXLEN=MAXLEN_UP=6, GEN_NMAX=3, TARGET_SEED=17
conventions: D-006 BMN conventions (fortuity.bmn.words); sector (2J; q1,q2,q3); x = U(1) components of the scalars (fortuity.bmn.blockrestrict.restrict_u1)
inputs: engine records: our (8,5,4) column (data/su3/hw_cohomology_8_5_4.json), T-042 (7,5,4), (8,4,4) (commit b08e01f), R-007 column from data/su3/bmn_hw_cohomology_j30.json; exact SU(3) dims to j = 36; exact SU(2) dims (fortuity.bmn.fullindex.partition_dims) certify the SU(2) target functionals
checked: per sector: the lower Q-images reach the certified rank r_down; self-check rank = m_d; compressed hw rows have rank m_d and their lower images rank r_down; closed space = m - r_down; non-graviton classes found = the engine count h - grav; every restricted image is closed in SU(2); every representative is closed at fresh N = 3 points. Cores (only (6;8,5,4) has one): the images of the combined expression have zero residue in every channel, and the core is closed at fresh N = 3 points. checks.core0_closed_N4 = false refers to the saved lift only: it is a random combination of the overcomplete hw rows, so it carries random N = 3 trace relations, which are generically not closed at N = 4; the flag does not test the class. Validation: R-007 (5;7,4,4) comes out fused, as in R-016, on the laptop (numpy) and on the cluster (BLIS kernels); unit tests code/tests/test_classreps_par.py (SU(2) O_0; dMK -648/5)
caveat: random evaluation over F_p (p = 2^26 - 5) with certified functionals on both sides (SU(3) sectors by the engine self-checks, SU(2) targets by their exact dimensions), so residues and ranks are exact over F_p; a bad prime is the usual residual caveat; classical (tree-level) cohomology
